description: Remove an invoice from Oblio for good. NO INVERSE. Oblio allows it only for the last number in a series, and anything already sent to ANAF stays there, so the two can end up out of step. cancel_invoice is almost always the right call instead. The invoice is read first: the answer says what it totalled (before), and with expect_total a call whose number names an invoice of another total changes nothing. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

expect_total.description: The total the invoice must have ("121.00"); when it differs nothing is changed. Recommended: a number can name the wrong invoice.

number.description: The document number as text, without its series: "0042" is not 42.

series_name.description: The document's series, exactly as list_series shows it.

name: delete_invoice
title: Delete an invoice permanently
